title: HINGE PILLAR INNER & OUTER REINF
summary: Door hinge pillar (A-pillar / windshield pillar) steel reinforcement in the body: the inner reinforcement (LH/RH) is spot-welded to the outer reinforcement along its length, with a small plate welded between them at the hinge area, and the joint flange sealed with sealer-adhesive 86a. Two small brackets are riveted onto the inner reinforcement (View A).

parts.name: REINF ASM-BODY HINGE PILLAR INNER L.H.
parts.name_expanded: Reinforcement assembly – body hinge pillar inner, LH

parts.name: R.H.
parts.name_expanded: Reinforcement assembly – body hinge pillar inner, RH

materials.where: entire flange between inner reinforcement [1] and outer reinforcement [3] (top of View A)

fastening.note: Spot welds. Plate [2] sits at the lower (hinge) end of the pillar; weld marks 2A and 2B in the right-hand view.
Spot welds 2C at the top of the plate where it meets the inner reinforcement.

Spot welds along the pillar flanges: 3A at the hinge box, 3B down the lower front flange (pitch 1.12-1.24), 3C up the upper pillar (pitch 1.38/1.50). Dimension callouts 2.24, .75, 1.24, 2.12, 2.00, 1.38, 2.12, .50 locate weld rows.
Sealer-adhesive 86a along the entire flange between [1] and [3].
View A (inboard face of the inner pillar): bracket [4] on the upper pillar and bracket [5] lower down, each held by one rivet [6].
